meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a local server when available and offering an evaluation server when none exists.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给 Mattermost 添加机器人频道,自动复用本地或评估服务器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队用 Mattermost 需要快速接入机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Add a Mattermost bot channel, auto-reusing local or evaluation server
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Mattermost and needs to quickly add a bot channel

howto.what: 装上此技能后,当你要接入 Mattermost 时,Claude 会先探测你已有的 Mattermost 服务器;若没有,会询问是否用 Docker 创建本地评估服务器,然后设置服务器地址、注册频道、创建机器人并配置回调,使 Claude 能收发 Mattermost 私信、频道消息等。
howto.when: 当你想让 Claude 接入 Mattermost,例如说「添加 Mattermost 频道」或「找一下本地有没有 Mattermost 服务器」时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加 Mattermost 机器人频道。
say.note: Claude 会先检查本机与配置文件里的服务器。

say.text: 接入我本地的 Mattermost 服务器。
帮我建一个本地 Mattermost 测试环境。
say.note: 安装前会先说明将创建的 Docker 资源并征求你同意。

howto.what_en: When you ask to add Mattermost, Claude probes for an existing local server, else offers a Docker-based evaluation server. It then configures server URL, bot account, callbacks, and registers the channel, enabling DMs and channel messages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a user asks to add, connect, or configure a Mattermost server or bot channel.

say_en.text: Add a Mattermost bot channel for me.
say_en.note: Claude detects local servers and asks how to proceed.

say_en.text: Use my local Mattermost server if one exists.
say_en.note: It probes localhost, env files, and Docker containers.

say_en.text: Set up a local Mattermost evaluation server for me.
say_en.note: This requires Docker and asks for approval first.
